exposure: Covid-19 infection during 3rd trimester or intrapartum
outcome: placental histopathologies (maternal vascular malperfusion, amniotic fluid infection, villitis of unknown etiology, intervillositis, chorangiosis, fetal vascular malperfusion, vascular ectasia)
cohort: The study included 22 Covid-19 positive and 21 Covid-19 negative pregnant women delivering between January and June 2021, with controls being previously healthy mothers with singleton, term, uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Covid-19 infection during the third trimester of pregnancy was not found to be a risk factor for most placental histopathologies, with the exception of vascular ectasia which was more frequently identified in the Covid-19 positive group.
gest_age: Term for controls; third trimester or intrapartum for Covid-19 infected mothers.
